settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subheading: Everything you need to know about our candles, diffusers, and home fragrances.

settings.question: How long do your candles burn?
settings.answer: Our 8 oz candles burn for approximately 40-50 hours, and our 13 oz candles burn for 70-80 hours. Always trim the wick to 1/4 inch before each lighting for optimal performance.

settings.question: What type of wax do you use?
settings.answer: We use 100% natural soy wax, which is clean-burning, renewable, and biodegradable. Soy wax also provides an excellent scent throw.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1-2 business days. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within the continental US. Expedited options are available at checkout.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer complimentary standard shipping on all orders over $75 within the continental US.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery on unopened items in original packaging. Used candles cannot be returned, but we stand behind our quality — if you're not satisfied, please contact us.

settings.question: How do I care for my candle?
settings.answer: Always trim the wick to 1/4 inch before lighting. Allow the wax to melt to the edges on the first burn (about 2 hours). Never burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Keep away from drafts.
